verdict.rationale: Token2 provides multiple guided-setup resources: a browser-based FIDO2/passkey registration demo (token2-docs-5/16), a backup-key setup FAQ (token2-docs-17), platform-specific integration guides for Entra ID, Intune, and Active Directory (token2-docs-22/23/25), and PIV/miniDriver configuration guides (token2-docs-11/24), plus companion apps for managing keys post-registration. However, there is no single unified onboarding wizard walking a first-time user end-to-end, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that these guides are beginner-friendly. Missing for 10: a first-party interactive setup wizard/app that walks a user through initial account registration, independent user reports confirming ease of first-time setup.
